parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: The personal access token. This parameter is optional when authenticating with an AccessKey or STS temporary authorization.

parameters.name: checkRunId
parameters.description: The ID of the check run.

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: The ID of the organization. You can obtain it from the URL of your Alibaba Cloud DevOps organization page, for example, `https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{OrganizationId}`.

parameters.name: repositoryIdentity
parameters.description: The ID or full path of the repository.
